issue: Trade-press reporting on the final stage of Fluxys' Zeebrugge regas expansion describes 'an additional 1.3 mtpa of additional sendout capacity' expected by early 2026 that actually came online early in January 2025. GEM models this final stage ('2025 Expansion' unit) at +1.0 mtpa. Small discrepancy (1.0 vs 1.3 mtpa). GEM's total post-expansion capacity (3.3 base + 3.3 [2008] + 4.7 [2024] + 1.0 [2025] = 12.3 mtpa) is in the same neighborhood as the ~11.3 mtpa (15 bcma) figure Fluxys cited after the 2024 stage. Not material enough to override GEM's per-unit split, which appears deliberately apportioned (researcher note: '116 million euros split proportionally by capacity between 2024 and 2026 expansions'). Logged for awareness.
suggested_action: No edit. If reconciling, note the +1.0 vs +1.3 mtpa difference on the final Zeebrugge stage; a researcher with the Fluxys subscription docs could confirm the exact incremental figure. GEM's apportioned split is internally consistent.
